title: Explicit per-device persistent web login

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 clock boundary changes no ERP identity or quantity; authentication does not supply or override business scope.

dnspyEvidence.source: Web-only device session storage. UserInfo SELECT reuses login fields; no EXE login or ERP write behavior is changed.

rules: Default unchecked preserves 8-hour JWT/cookie and external Bearer policy.
Persistent cookie is host-only HttpOnly Secure in production SameSite=Strict; 400-day inactivity limit renewed once per day of use.
Opaque 256-bit token is never returned in JSON or stored in localStorage; server filenames use SHA256, credential proof keyed HMAC, runtime files excluded from Git.
API and SSR await current UserInfo read, reject deleted or password-changed account and use current permissions; database and storage errors fail closed.
Logout and successful new login revoke only the old device session, with tombstone preserving logout during renewal; no silent request replay.
Standard browser and existing Electron persist:nenova-work share the web login UI code without requiring a native installer update.
